reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is bisglycinate with no oxide, a dose written on the box and a batch report I can check against the batch number. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one and see how I feel.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a lot to swallow, and I would want to open the lab report and see that the dose really matches before I order a second box.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page were missing, did not match the batch number, or showed a dose different from the box, I would not buy.
